title: Does the first live call for a run wait?
body:
**Chose:** a run's first call is `factory live <id> --json` with neither `--since` nor `--wait`; every later call carries `--since <seq> --wait 20`. After a failed call the loop waits 10 s before the next, and never starts two calls less than 1 s apart.
**Over:** `--wait 20` on the first call too, and retrying at once after a failure.
**Because:** with nothing held yet, a waited first call could leave the panel on "Loading…" for 20 s. A failing factory (exit 1, exit 2, missing binary) answers instantly, so an immediate retry would spawn processes in a tight loop while the panel is shown.
**Undo:** `liveArgs` in `mods/factory-run/lib/live.js` and `RETRY_MS`/`MIN_GAP_MS` in `mods/factory-run/main.js`.

title: A run switch does not wait for the old run's held call
body:
**Chose:** a chip click or space switch starts the new run's loop at once. The old loop's held `--wait 20` call is left to return. Its answer is dropped, and that loop then ends without calling factory again. Only one loop calls factory at a time, but for up to 20 s two calls can be in flight.
**Over:** a single loop that finishes the old run's held call before asking about the new run.
**Because:** that delays the new run's first draw by up to 20 s after every switch. A token per loop (`this.serving`) and the id check in `apply` together keep the stale answer out of the held timeline.
**Undo:** `wake` and `loop` in `mods/factory-run/main.js`.

title: A section importing gpui-kit gets an unignored gpui-kit.d.ts
body: `herdr-app check` (the mods tier of `make inner`) writes `gpui-kit.d.ts` into `mods/factory-run/sections/` once a section imports gpui-kit, and `.gitignore` covers only `mods/*/gpui-kit.d.ts`: delete `mods/factory-run/sections/gpui-kit.d.ts` after the last inner run, or it lands in the slice commit.

title: Where the section folder's generated gpui-kit.d.ts goes
body:
**Chose:** delete the generated `mods/factory-run/sections/gpui-kit.d.ts` after the inner loop, leaving `.gitignore` alone.
**Over:** adding `mods/*/*/gpui-kit.d.ts` to `.gitignore`.
**Because:** `.gitignore` is outside this slice's files, and slices 03, 05 and 06 each hit the same file in their own section folder, so one line there serves them all and is the owner's to add.
**Undo:** add `mods/*/*/gpui-kit.d.ts` and `mods/*/*/jsconfig.json` to `.gitignore`.

title: jq is a test-only dependency of the fake factory
body:
**Chose:** the fake factory shapes its answers with `jq`, checked by `fake-factory-live.sh build`.
**Over:** a Node helper (the shell that `exec()` spawns may lack the mise Node the gate uses) or pure bash (no JSON).
**Because:** jq is installed here, as sqlite3 is for the fixture builder, and keeps the fake one shellchecked script.
**Undo:** port `use` and `live` in `tests/fixtures/fake-factory-live.sh` to Node.

title: The fake runs the wrapper as a child, to log its exit code
body:
**Chose:** for any call without a case, the fake runs the wrapper as a child and exits with its code, instead of `exec`ing it; each `calls.log` line also carries the call's duration.
**Over:** `exec`, as the slice worded it.
**Because:** the slice also asks every call's exit code in the log, which an `exec` cannot write; the duration shows when a held `--wait` answered.
**Undo:** `serve` in `tests/fixtures/fake-factory-live.sh`.

title: A case's times move to the moment of use
body:
**Chose:** `use` moves every RFC3339 time in a case so its `at` is now, rewrites `branch` and the attention `answer` feature with `id`, `feature` and `repo`, and `drop`s the previous case's files first.
**Over:** canned times frozen at 2026-11-07T10:00Z and only the three fields the slice named.
**Because:** a panel showing "since 40 days" or an Answer argv for the wrong feature would invalidate the screenshots.
**Undo:** the jq filter in `use`.

title: Ignore the gpui-kit.d.ts herdr-app writes into a mod's sub-folders
body:
**Chose:** one line in `.gitignore`, `mods/*/*/gpui-kit.d.ts`, beside the existing `mods/*/gpui-kit.d.ts`.
**Over:** keeping the section free of `gpui-kit` imports, or deleting the file after each gate run.
**Because:** once `mods/factory-run/sections/now.js` imports `gpui-kit`, `herdr-app check` (the mods tier) writes a 22k-line `gpui-kit.d.ts` into `sections/`, and the driver would commit it. Slices 04-06 draw their sections the same way and hit it too. It ignores a generated file and loosens no gate.
**Undo:** drop the line from `.gitignore`.

title: The Now line's own words for since, done and stopping
body:
**Chose:** `since` is drawn as a duration up to the envelope's `at` ("for 12m"), like idle time and an entry's "open 12m". `waitingOn: done` leads with "Done"; every other value, unknown ones included, with "Waiting on <value>". `stopping` reads "stopping, waiting on <on>: <what>". Progress is drawn as "7/12" right after the label, so a label "review" reads "review · 7/12". Idle time and the decision count are left out at zero. An entry's title falls back to its id. A `block` or `ask` always gets Answer, even with no `answer` argv: the dialog then says the question carries no answer command.
**Over:** "since 14:02" as a clock time, "Waiting on done", and hiding Answer when the argv is missing.
**Because:** the PRD names these words but not their exact form. A duration reads at a glance, and every duration on the panel is measured against `at`, so tests are fixed. Hiding Answer would drop a missing argv without a word.
**Undo:** `nowLine`, `lead` and `attentionBlocks` in `mods/factory-run/lib/now.js`.

title: A mod sub-folder whose file imports gpui-kit gets a gpui-kit.d.ts from the mods tier
body: `herdr-app check` writes `gpui-kit.d.ts` next to any file that imports `gpui-kit`, `sections/` included. `.gitignore` now covers `mods/*/*/gpui-kit.d.ts`; check `git status` after `make inner` for any other generated file.

title: What the gate block draws when the gate is neither running nor red
body:
**Chose:** a finished green gate draws its head line only ("Gate 1 · attempt 1 · green in 2m", "cached" when cached), with neither tail nor excerpt. A running head reads "Gate n · attempt a · <cmd> · running <elapsed>", elapsed from `startedAt` to the envelope's `at`. CI draws nothing while `state` is `none`; running checks are listed only while it is `waiting`. A timeline row with no `label` falls back to its `kind`, and an unknown tone is muted.
**Over:** the last 8 tail lines for a green gate too.
**Because:** FR-6 names the tail for a running gate and the excerpt for a red one, and says nothing of a green one. Every finished run has a green gate with a 40-line tail, so drawing it would move the timeline down on every run for output nobody reads once it passed.
**Undo:** `gateView` and `ciView` in `mods/factory-run/lib/gate.js`.

title: What the shots section does with evidence it does not copy
body:
**Chose:** an image that will never be copied (over 4 MiB, outside the newest 24, an extension outside png/jpg/jpeg/gif/webp/svg, or a bad etag) is listed by name and size with the non-image files; an unstable image is not shown until it is stable; an entry whose `path` leaves the evidence folder is not shown at all. Names are the file's base name. Before copying, `realpath -e` of the evidence folder and of the file's folder must nest, so a symlinked folder inside evidence is refused too, not only a symlinked file. An answer landing during a copy pass is kept and copied for once the pass ends, never in a second pass beside it.
**Over:** dropping uncopyable images silently, listing rejected paths, and dropping the answer that lands mid-pass.
**Because:** the PRD names what to copy and that non-image evidence is listed, but not what an image that is never copied shows; a hidden one would read as missing evidence. A hostile path is not evidence. The folder check closes the one route `cp -P` still follows (a symlink in a parent folder).
**Undo:** `plan` in `mods/factory-run/lib/shots.js`; `copy` and `update` in `mods/factory-run/sections/shots.js`.
